summary: Russian forces launched a massive overnight attack on Odesa using strike UAVs and guided bombs, killing and injuring civilians including a child, damaging port infrastructure, energy facilities, and residential buildings. The 'North' grouping advanced up to 800 meters on 19 sections in the Sumy direction near Kiyanitsa and Khoteni. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 141 of 174 incoming attack drones and missiles, though multiple reactive Shaheds penetrated defenses striking Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district residential building and railway infrastructure.
key_points: Russian overnight attack on Odesa damaged four energy facilities, an unmanned boat production enterprise, six fuel tanks, a high-rise, two educational institutions, leaving parts of the city without power and injuring eight including a child (Source: @UkraineNow/83830, @tass_agency/393209, @tass_agency/393211).

Russian 'North' group advanced on 19 sections in Sumy direction near Kiyanitsa and Khoteni, gaining up to 800 meters in 24 hours, while also advancing near Ulanovo and Tolstodubovo in Shostka district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of Novopavlovka and Chervona Krynytsia in Zaporizhzhia region on different flanks of Orikhiv direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32910, @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Ukrainian air defense reported destroying 141 of 174 incoming targets overnight, including 3 S8000 'Banderoil' and 138 Shahed/Gerbera/Parodiya UAVs launched from Orel, occupied Donetsk, and Crimea (Source: @kpszsu/75880).

Multiple reactive Shahed UAVs struck Kyiv: a 6-story residential building in Shevchenkivskyi district caught fire, two hit railway infrastructure near Kyiv-Tovarnyi, others targeted Demiivka/TEC-5 and Nyvky areas, causing four injuries (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73196, @mon1tor_ua/73199, @mon1tor_ua/73169, @UkraineNow/83840).

Shootout between SBU and GUR erupted on Shumsky Street in Kyiv, reportedly linked to SBU detention of Russian Volunteer Corps deputy commander Stepan Kaplunov (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32933, @tass_agency/393232).

Russian air defenses destroyed 109 Ukrainian UAVs over Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kaluga, Kursk, Oryol, Moscow regions, Crimea, and Black Sea, with four more downed near Moscow causing airport restrictions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).
Zelensky announced campaign to block Russian airspace, declaring 'Russian sky becoming completely unsafe,' prompting immediate Aeroflot share decline (Source: @UkraineNow/83828).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces executed a large-scale combined arms attack on Odesa overnight, striking port energy infrastructure, fuel storage, and civilian objects with UAVs and guided bombs, resulting in eight casualties including a child and widespread power outages. Simultaneously, the Russian 'North' grouping conducted significant offensive operations in the Sumy direction, advancing up to 800 meters across 19 sectors near Kiyanitsa and Khoteni. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 141 of 174 incoming aerial targets nationwide, though reactive Shahed drones penetrated Kyiv's defenses hitting a residential building, railway infrastructure, and energy facilities, while a shootout between Ukrainian security services erupted in central Kyiv.

points: Ukrainian air defense forces intercepted 141 of 174 Russian attack assets overnight, including 3 S8000 'Banderoil' cruise missiles and 138 Shahed/Gerbera/Parodiya UAVs launched from Orel, occupied Donetsk, and Crimea, with main attack axes targeting Odesa and Kyiv regions (Source: @kpszsu/75880).

A shootout between SBU and GUR personnel occurred on Shumsky Street in Kyiv, reportedly triggered by SBU detention of Russian Volunteer Corps deputy commander Stepan Kaplunov, with military lawyer Taras Borovsky confirming the link (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32933, @tass_agency/393232).

President Zelensky declared a campaign to 'block Russian airspace,' stating 'Russian sky becoming completely unsafe,' which immediately caused Aeroflot shares to fall, signaling an escalation in information and economic warfare (Source: @UkraineNow/83828).

Ukrainian UAVs attacked a humanitarian convoy of four vehicles carrying food and medicine near Aleshky in Kherson region, injuring one volunteer and destroying all vehicles and cargo, according to Russian-aligned sources (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Kyiv metro experienced severe overcrowding and operational collapse due to prolonged air raid alerts, with passengers 'standing on each other' unable to reach workplaces, highlighting civil defense strain (Source: @UkraineNow/83833).

Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Grushko stated at WEF that NATO is preparing for military confrontation with Russia, citing alliance exercise orientations and military logistics development on the eastern flank as evidence (Source: @tass_agency/393239).

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed overnight strikes on four energy infrastructure facilities in Odesa region ensuring port functionality, plus an unmanned boat experimental production enterprise and six fuel tanks in Odesa port (Source: @tass_agency/393209, @tass_agency/393211).

Russian 'North' grouping assault groups advanced on 19 sections in Sumy direction near Kiyanitsa and Khoteni, achieving up to 800 meters total advance in 24 hours, with continued advances near Ulanovo and Tolstodubovo in Shostka district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Russian MoD announced liberation of Novopavlovka and Chervona Krynytsia settlements in Zaporizhzhia region, located on different flanks of the Orikhiv direction, with fighting continuing near Orikhiv (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32910, @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Russian air defenses destroyed 109 Ukrainian aircraft-type UAVs over Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kaluga, Kursk, Oryol, Moscow regions, Crimea, and Black Sea from 08:00 to 20:00 Sept 1, with four more intercepted near Moscow causing Vnukovo and Domodedovo airport restrictions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

First Deputy PM Manturov stated temporary external administration decisions will be made at the highest level after achieving security or restoration goals, applicable to enterprises or controlling persons (Source: @tass_agency/393216, @tass_agency/393230).

In the Krasnolimansk direction, fighting remains positional near Lyman with Ukrainian counterattacks from the south and Drobyshevo area, while the Redkodub-Novoye sector remains unstable as Russian units attempt to improve positions and fix Ukrainian reserves (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Dobropillia direction sees fierce fighting in Rubizhne, Annovka, Novonikolaevka, Staroandriivka, and Novoandriivka, with Ukrainian forces counterattacking to prevent further expansion of the Russian wedge (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

On the Zaporizhzhia front, Russian forces claimed liberation of Novopavlovka and Chervona Krynytsia on different flanks of the Orikhiv direction, while fighting continues near Orikhiv; in Melitopol, a Ukrainian FPV drone attacked a civilian vehicle seriously injuring three civilians per regional authorities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).
Russian KAB guided bombs struck targets in Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, and Donetsk regions, indicating continued use of glide bomb tactics against front-line and rear areas (Source: @kpszsu/75899).

In the Kharkiv direction, heavy fighting continues in Kazachya Lopan and Hoptivka; near Volchansk, Russian units advance near Sliznevo and Dolzhanka while Ukrainian forces transfer reserves, armor, and UAV units; advances reported westward in Velikoburluk area (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Russian 'North' grouping advanced on 19 sections in Sumy direction near Kiyanitsa and Khoteni, gaining up to 800 meters in 24 hours, with continued advances in Shostka district near Ulanovo and Tolstodubovo (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Belgorod region suffered civilian casualties: a woman killed in Dunayka, Graivoron district by drone attack; wounded reported in Belgorod city, on Rakitnoe-Proletarsky and Svyatoslavka-Bobrava roads, and near Novosadovo; overnight Shebekino drone strikes injured three more men (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Reactive Shahed UAVs launched from Bryansk region targeted Chernihiv region (Chernihiv district), while Kursk region launches targeted Sumy region (Sumy district), per monitoring channels (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73204).

Multiple reactive UAV groups detected launching from Orel (10 groups noted) toward Chernihiv and Kyiv regions, with specific tracks toward Slavutych, Horodnya, and southern Chernihiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/109745, @kpszsu/75884, @kpszsu/75868).

Chernihiv region experienced sustained reactive UAV activity with launches from Orel and Bryansk regions, targeting areas including Slavutych, Horodnya, and Chernihiv district, prompting repeated air alerts (Source: @eRadarrua/109774, @eRadarrua/109777, @kpszsu/75904).

Massive Russian overnight attack on Odesa used strike UAVs and FAB guided bombs in multiple waves, damaging a high-rise, two educational institutions, energy infrastructure, leaving parts of the city without electricity, with eight injured including a child (Source: @UkraineNow/83830, @eRadarrua/109761).

Russian MoD confirmed strikes on four energy facilities ensuring port operations, an unmanned boat experimental production enterprise, and six fuel tanks in Odesa port (Source: @tass_agency/393209, @tass_agency/393211).

Reactive UAVs launched from Black Sea waters targeted Mykolaiv region (Ochakiv area) and Zaporizhzhia city from the south, per monitoring channels (Source: @kpszsu/75889, @kpszsu/75905, @kpszsu/75890).

In Kherson direction, Russian forces struck identified military facilities and enemy depots in Kherson city, while Ukrainian UAVs attacked a humanitarian convoy of four vehicles near Aleshky, destroying vehicles and cargo, injuring one volunteer (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).
Vyshneve in Kyiv region (southern suburb) saw two townhouses destroyed by Russian attack, with casualty information being clarified (Source: @UkraineNow/83830).

Russia launched 174 attack assets overnight: 2 Iskander-M ballistic missiles from occupied Crimea, 2 Kh-59/69 guided air missiles from Black Sea airspace, and 170 Shahed/S8000/Gerbera/Parodiya UAVs from Orel, occupied Donetsk, and Crimea, primarily targeting Odesa and Kyiv regions (Source: @kpszsu/75880).

Ukrainian air defense reported 141 interceptions: 3 S8000 'Banderoil' and 138 Shahed/Gerbera/Parodiya UAVs, with impacts confirmed at 16 locations and debris falls at 4 locations; attack continued into morning with UAVs remaining in airspace (Source: @kpszsu/75880).

Reactive 'Geran-4/5' Shahed variants launched from Orel-Polygon in Oryol region, with 10 launch groups detected; multiple impacts in Kyiv including Shevchenkivskyi residential building, railway infrastructure near Kyiv-Tovarnyi, Demiivka/TEC-5, and Nyvky areas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73202, @mon1tor_ua/73196, @mon1tor_ua/73199, @mon1tor_ua/73169).

Russian air defense destroyed 109 Ukrainian UAVs over eight Russian regions plus Crimea and Black Sea during daytime Sept 1, with four additional interceptions near Moscow causing Vnukovo and Domodedovo airport restrictions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).

Ukrainian UAV activity included strikes on Russian humanitarian convoy near Aleshky (Kherson region) and FPV attack on civilian vehicle in Melitopol (Zaporizhzhia), while Russian KAB glide bombs hit Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Donetsk regions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934, @kpszsu/75899).

key_developments: Russian massive overnight strike on Odesa with UAVs and FABs hit 4 energy facilities, unmanned boat plant, 6 fuel tanks, residential high-rise, 2 schools; 8 injured including child, power outages (Source: @UkraineNow/83830, @tass_agency/393209, @tass_agency/393211).
Russian 'North' group advanced 800m on 19 sectors in Sumy direction near Kiyanitsa/Khoteni; advances continue near Ulanovo/Tolstodubovo in Shostka district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).
Ukrainian AD intercepted 141/174 Russian attack assets (3 S8000, 138 Shahed/Gerbera/Parodiya) launched from Orel, occupied Donetsk, Crimea; main axes Odesa/Kyiv (Source: @kpszsu/75880).

Reactive Shaheds penetrated Kyiv defenses: 6-story residential building fire in Shevchenkivskyi, 2 hits on railway infrastructure near Kyiv-Tovarnyi, strikes on Demiivka/TEC-5 and Nyvky; 4 injured (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73196, @mon1tor_ua/73199, @mon1tor_ua/73169, @UkraineNow/83840).
SBU-GUR shootout on Shumsky Street, Kyiv, linked to SBU detention of Russian Volunteer Corps deputy commander Stepan Kaplunov (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32933, @tass_agency/393232).

Russian MoD claims liberation of Novopavlovka and Chervona Krynytsia in Zaporizhzhia region on Orikhiv direction flanks; fighting near Orikhiv continues (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32910, @ukr_leaks_eng/32934).
Zelensky announces campaign to block Russian airspace, declares 'Russian sky completely unsafe'; Aeroflot shares drop immediately (Source: @UkraineNow/83828).
sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous massive strike on Odesa's port infrastructure and deep advances in Sumy indicate a coordinated Russian effort to degrade Ukrainian logistics in the south while pressuring the northern flank. The penetration of reactive Shaheds into central Kyiv despite high interception rates suggests evolving Russian drone tactics overwhelming point defenses. The SBU-GUR shootout reveals dangerous fragmentation within Ukrainian security services that could impair rear-area security. Russian liberation claims in Zaporizhzhia, if confirmed, would widen their control on Orikhiv flanks, complicating Ukrainian counteroffensive planning. The humanitarian convoy attack near Aleshky signals willingness to target aid operations, potentially restricting civilian relief.
